item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day's packed with movement, focus work, and quiet reflection back to back, and water is the easiest thing to forget in the shuffle. Dehydration doesn't always show up as thirst — it shows up as fatigue, brain fog, or a shorter fuse than usual. All the mental and physical effort planned today runs better on a hydrated body. Action: drink a full glass of water right now, before you move to the next thing.
